svg.title: Становая тяга на прямых ногах с гантелями — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift, precise three-quarter side view. Left: stand tall with two recognizable dumbbells, one in each hand near thighs, arms straight. Right: hinge at hips and push them back, torso roughly horizontal and spine neutral, arms hanging vertically holding dumbbells close to shins. Both knees stay almost straight but soft; legs do not perform a squat. Both feet fully grounded. The two separate dumbbells never touch one another or floor. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
